assertions: A fresh isolated Pitcher account was seeded with current policy acceptance and a unique Gmail plus-address; the deployed API created one unverified account and sent a real activation email.
The controlled Pitcher Gmail inbox received the activation message addressed to the unique fixture alias; the activation token is intentionally redacted from retained evidence.
Opening the real one-time activation URL in an already authenticated Pitcher Chrome session displayed the successful verification state and a Go to dashboard CTA whose href was /dashboard.
Clicking Go to dashboard navigated to /dashboard and rendered the Pitcher Dashboard, rather than falling through to the root route.
The activation link was consumed exactly once and no existing user's password was changed.
